instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark theme is active by default on first load, with a working toggle for light mode.
Import Space Grotesk and Inter fonts from Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, navigation links, theme toggle, contact submit).
Implement glassmorphism cards with subtle border gradients and inner glow effects.
Connect the contact form to backend POST /api/contact or local state with Sonner notification feedback.
Avoid generic AI slop centered text; use asymmetric bento grids, editorial typography, and generous spacing.
Do NOT use markdown code blocks inside design_guidelines.json, keep it clean JSON.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, links, inputs, and interactive components MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme_handling: Respect dark mode default with localStorage persistence.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.glassmorphism_rule: Use backdrop-blur-xl with semi-transparent background and 1px subtle border.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use p-6 to p-12 for containers to allow luxury breathing room.
